description: This file defines the RetryMiddleware class for AWS SDK, implementing retry logic for failed requests, including default decider creation, retry conditions, exponential delay, and request handling.

classes.name: RetryMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that handles retry logic for AWS SDK requests, supporting legacy mode and exponential backoff with jitter.

methods.name: createDefaultDecider
methods.description: Creates a default retry decider function with configurable max retries and extra conditions.

methods.name: isRetryable
methods.description: Determines if a request is retryable based on result, error, and configuration.

methods.name: exponentialDelay
methods.description: Calculates an exponential backoff delay with jitter based on retry count.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing retry middleware with decider, delay, next handler, and stats collection flag.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the retry logic execution for a command and request, managing retries, delays, and stats.
